hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Encrypt each integer by replacing all of its digits with its largest digit.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: For a number with L digits and maximum digit d, the encrypted value is d multiplied by (10^L - 1) // 9.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Encrypt each element in nums and sum the results.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: L: number of digits per integer (at most 4)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct digit conversion is already optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Extract maximum digit and replicate it to match original length.
